findings.text: reapable_watch_pids now defaults include_named_half=True, so its two existing call sites — tests/test_the_session_reap_signals_a_pruned_producer.py:112 and :155, and tests/test_test_watchers_are_reaped.py:248 — silently gain the whole-host /proc environ scan they were written without, and the session-reap test's docstring ('what reapable_watch_pids returns is what reaped_watch_producers sends SIGTERM to') no longer matches the fixture, which passes include_named_half=False. They pass today only because their stub producers' argv lacks 'watch'/'--project', so unrecorded_watch_producers_naming matches none of them; a stub with a watch-shaped argv would silently change their result sets and could make the pruned-home test pass through the environ path rather than the mirrored record it exists to prove. The records-only path should be expressed at those call sites (include_named_half=False) rather than inherited from a default the per-test reap now overrides by passing armed.
